positions.name: PipelineIdGeneration
positions.frame: how does the memory pipeline produce identification when no explicit id is supplied?
positions.why: src-1 records the triggering condition — a submission without an explicit id field — while src-2 prescribes the pipeline's required response: generate a slug from content via the LLM id-gen call or the deterministic slugify fallback, then commit the file. Together they cohere around the pipeline's responsibility to produce identification autonomously when none is provided, spanning from the factual past-state claim to the directive future-requirement.
